create.name: Guru Viking Podcast
create.bio:
The Guru Viking Podcast is a long-form interview show hosted by Steve James, a researcher and writer on religion and belief who is studying for a doctorate in Asian and Middle Eastern Studies at Oxford after an MPhil there in Tibetan and Himalayan Studies. James trained as a yoga teacher, has studied meditation with Shinzen Young and Tibetan tradition with Glenn Mullin, and created the Movement Koan Method, which joins gentle movement with body-based mindfulness.

Running on YouTube since 2016, the show now has close to four hundred episodes, usually one to three hours long. Guests range across Buddhist meditation and jhana practice, Zen, Tibetan Vajrayana and Bon, Chan, Hindu tantra and Western esoteric traditions, and include teachers and scholars such as Guo Gu, Alejandro Chaoul, Leigh Brasington, Christopher Wallis, Ken Wilber and Glenn Mullin. James asks detailed questions about practice, lineage and the realities of spiritual communities, including the difficult ones. The website also hosts a free online meditation group, currently paused.
